title: PAR-07/S8 partially overlapping DataStorage record headers
mode: ODA-guided parser fix with generated fast regression
scope: Reject DataIndex rows that point to partially overlapping fixed-size data-record headers
Prevent ambiguous headers from contributing payload boundary offsets
Preserve an independently bounded following record and its exact payload
Update the implementation plan and continue without external qualification gates

method.limitations: The generated vector validates local parser bounds and record disposition only. It does not establish how a producer emits malformed overlaps, ACIS semantics, or native consumer behavior. The pre-fix selector failed, but its individual diagnostic components were not printed; the failure was fixed by the added overlap-specific disposition.

formatBasis.authority: ODA defines DataIndex local offsets as references into data-record segments and describes a repeated fixed field sequence for each record header before the payload region
formatBasis.expectedDisposition: Distinct DataIndex rows whose fixed-size record-header spans overlap are structurally ambiguous; neither row contributes a record boundary, while unrelated bounded rows remain parseable.

behavior: Collect in-bounds (segment, localOffset) pairs into sorted vector scratch bounded by the DataIndex row count before constructing payload-boundary offsets.
Detect overlapping 20-byte header spans and mark every row in each overlap cluster structurally invalid.
Emit deterministic diagnostics in DataIndex order and exclude the overlapping rows from both payload-boundary inference and record parsing.
Use binary search over the sorted overlap vector rather than allocating a per-entry hash-node set.
Retain the third independently bounded record and verify its payload bytes exactly.
Add the focused --acds-overlapping-record-headers selector to the existing matrix-test executable; the default matrix test also calls the new owner, with no extra CTest registration.
implementation.redControl: Before the production change, the generated focused selector failed because no overlap-specific structural disposition was reported.
